request.description: One tiny tasteful ambient clam for a magical submerged ancient court pixel-art game. NOT a character: no eyes, no face, no skeleton, no crown. Low broad scalloped bivalve shell resting on a tiny dark teal rock contact foot. Open upper shell with subtle radial ribs, muted aqua blue outer shell and soft dusty mauve inner mantle, a very small pale pearl. Side-on three-quarter view appropriate to a 2D platform scene. Keep the entire occupied prop small: about 30 pixels wide and 23 pixels tall, centered inside this 64x64 transparent canvas, plenty of empty padding. Dark clear outline, top-left light, chunky connected 2-3-tone material planes, restrained tiny highlights. Native crisp game pixel sprite, no blur, no anti-alias, no noisy individual flecks, no glow halo, no large surrounding reef, no text. Match the style reference's economical rendering and strong contour only, do not copy its subject or colors.
request.palette_name: Drowned Court shell and teal ruin material palette

style_image.usage_description: Rattlebones is rendering authority only: crisp outline, connected simple shading clusters and native pixels. Do not copy anatomy, equipment, or palette.
